name: sign-more-horizontal-words
title: Sign: more-horizontal (words)
description: A sign for "more", drawn as words along its strokes.

files.content:
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "more",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "O",
        12,
        12,
        1,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "O",
        19,
        12,
        1,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "O",
        5,
        12,
        1,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignMoreHorizontalWords(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="words" {...props} />
}

export { SignMoreHorizontalWords, shape }
